lines.text: The LORD builds up Jerusalem, gathers the exiles of Israel, and heals the brokenhearted.
The LORD calls each star by name, and He sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.
God covers the sky with clouds, makes grass grow on the hills, and provides food for the young lions.
The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, and He fills Zion with the finest wheat.
God melts the hail with His word and declares His statutes and judgments to Esau and Israel.
